page.body:
Export Listings XML

PropertyList.es enables you to effortlessly export your property listings as an XML URL, a powerful tool for expanding your reach across multiple platforms including your own website.

To import properties to your account click here

Requirements

  • A PropertyList account with administrative privileges.

Steps

  1. Access the Export Section: Log in to your PropertyList.es account and navigate to the “Import & Exports” tab on the left-hand side menu.
  2. Choose the XML Format: Click “+NEW EXPORT FEED” and select a format from the dropdown list. To export all properties to your own website, select “PropertyList”.
  3. Filter Properties (Optional): Customise which properties are included using the filters below. If no filtering is selected, the export will include all of your listings.
    • Private Notes: Add a note for this feed.
    • Property Order: Choose to order properties by newest or oldest first.
    • Max Listing Count: Set a maximum number of properties to export.
    • Include Sales: Checkbox to include properties for sale.
    • Set Prices (Sales): Select minimum and maximum sale prices.
    • Include Rentals: Checkbox to include properties for long-term rent.
    • Set Prices (Rentals): Select minimum and maximum monthly rental prices.
    • Location: Focus on specific areas by exporting listings within chosen locations.
    • Property Type: Select specific property types (e.g., apartments, villas, commercial spaces).
    • Bedrooms: Filter based on the number of bedrooms (e.g., studios, 1-bedroom, 2+ bedrooms).
    • Features: Filter based on available features like swimming pools, parking, or balconies.
    • Tags: Utilise any relevant tags you’ve assigned to your listings to further refine the export (e.g., “luxury”, “sea view”, “Idealista”).

    Each export has different criteria.

  4. Initiate the Export: Click “Save” to start the export process. You will receive a confirmation message.
  5. Obtain the XML URL: Upon successful export, PropertyList.es will provide an XML URL. Copy this URL to share it with other platforms.
  6. Edit / Disable: You can edit or disable your feed in the “Import & Export” main section.

Notes

  • Regular Updates: When you export to your website, it will be updated every 24h until you turn off the feature.
  • Backup: Always keep a backup of your website and original listings before making any changes.
  • XML Structure: Understanding the XML file structure isn’t required when using this method.

By following these steps and taking advantage of the optional filtering capabilities, you can export your property listings as a tailored XML URL on PropertyList.es. This exported data can then be uploaded to numerous websites, significantly increasing your reach and streamlining your listing management process.
